observations.why: Imperative command demanding erasure of knowledge, performing insistence without offering rationale — a pressure tactic backed by the implicit cost of non-compliance.
Direct imperative to delete knowledge, repeating the demand without justification — continued insistence as pressure, the verb framing non-compliance as carrying a cost.

mints.title: imperative command to forget or remove knowledge
mints.frame: Is the speaker issuing a direct demand to eliminate held knowledge, without offering rationale or inviting consultation?
